digest.component_or_area: enrichment queue and ticket digest storage
propositions: Physical deletion of committed UUID event files provides no repository space savings because git blob history is immutable; prune reclaims only checkout size while adding merge conflicts and commits.

Current queue reduction opens every matching event file (4,977 opens per full-store scan); a newest-first suffix-lazy reader bounded by event type and timestamp-ordered filenames needs only 1,658 opens, with lexicographic filename order matching monotonic timestamp order by construction.

The enrichment drain gate checks pending_enrichment on every write against a 20 ms budget but observes 404–544 ms latency due to unbounded O(history) file opens; a read bound eliminates the asymptotic growth term.

Any merge-safe deletion must rename to a deterministic source-derived path with identical content; fresh-UUID additions paired with deletes cause git rename-detection conflicts and violate invariant I1.
